claims: All nine frozen file hashes and the manifest-order composite independently matched the manifest.

The frozen profiles themselves keep identity and external evidence byte-identical within each family, use cumulative baseline evidence, and expose plausible work records and answerable or testable questions.

The lifecycle validator does not bind evidence content or claim text to conflict versus correction semantics. Swapping those fields in RANGE-INTERNAL-CARE-I1 while preserving IDs, types, timestamps, links and the frozen lifecycle oracle returned no errors, and the emitted contradicted input contained the original correction statement.

The blind-input leak check scans only strongestSupportedView, expectedDiagnosticBehaviours and forbiddenClaims. Adding routeChangingQuestion to an emitted input still satisfies the implemented oracle-leak predicate.
Exact lifecycle behaviour can therefore be faked, and an answer-bearing oracle field can enter a supposedly blind input without the deterministic gate noticing.
